note: the whole dict is the cell's config (furniture_cell.cell.Cell reads sim_cap_s, camera_budget_frames, max_ticks_per_step, settle_s, program_time_cap_s, silence_s); verify.py reads episodes, the caps, cpu_cap_factor (x program_time_cap_s = the program's CPU seconds), runner_account (the account the program runs as), lab_account (the practice lab's account, killed and frozen at verify start), privileged_program_time_cap_s (the oracle's episodes), socket_sample_s and route_gate. program_time_cap_s caps the program's own time per episode: the wall clock minus the cell's simulation (step) and rendering (get_camera), which the sim cap and the frame budget bound (cellkit.wire); silence_s caps the time from a reply to the next request
